# Drawer

A modal panel anchored to an edge of the screen.

```tsx
import { Drawer } from '@kafka-ds/react'
```

## When to use it

- For filters, settings or longer forms that keep context with the page.

## When not to

- For short confirmations: use Confirm dialog.

## Examples

### Side panel

Same behaviour as a modal, anchored to an edge.

```tsx
<Demo />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `side` | `'start' \| 'end' \| 'bottom'` | `'end'` | Edge it slides from. `end` is the right edge in left-to-right languages. |
| …rest | `ModalProps` | | Everything else is passed to the underlying element. |

## Accessibility

- Same behaviour as Modal.
- `side` is `start`, `end` or `bottom`; on small screens it takes the full width.

## Content

- Use `bottom` for phone-first flows.

## Tokens

Component tokens, all aliasing semantic tokens (see [tokens.md](../tokens.md)). CSS variable = `--kafka-` + the path in kebab-case.
